_meta.purpose: Deterministic sanity bounds for DtxReplay metrics ingested into data/dtx/<id>.json. Guards against the routine capturing a corrupt/param-drifted replay result (trade-count blowup, DD explosion) and publishing it to the status page. Consumed by assertReplaySanity() in tools/dtx-scan.js.
_meta.source: Healthy MCP rehearsal 2026-07-08 + live diagnostic 2026-07-10 (DtxReplay from=2021-01-01 to=2026-07-06, server commit 9a680ed).
_meta.incident: 2026-07-09 nightly routine published us_highvol 1169tr/DD-63%, etf_eu 3404tr/DD-89.6%, stockbox 1470tr/DD-41% — NOT reproducible on the server (which returns ~635/~1102/~172 tr, DD ~-28/-30/-25%). Bug was upstream param drift; this guard catches the signature (2-8x trade blowup + DD>50%) so it never reaches publish again.
_meta.note: total_trades grows ~monotonically as the window extends past 2026-07-06 (a few trades/week). ratio bounds are generous to avoid false positives on legitimate window extension; the DD/sharpe/win_rate/cagr bounds are the primary tripwires.
